title: TrackTok: Object-Centric Video Tokenization with Semantically Persistent Tokens
title_zh: TrackTok：基于语义持久令牌的对象中心视频令牌化

paragraphs.en: We introduce TrackTok , an efficient video tokenization framework that produces object-centric tokens, i.e., tokens that consistently encode the same semantic objects across time, even as it moves, deforms, or undergoes partial occlusion. Conventional patch-based or existing holistic tokenizers produce token identities often tied to fixed image locations. In contrast, our approach learns temporally persistent object-centric representations that bind visual features across frames into stable semantic units. This enables substantially more compact, continuous latent video representations, reducing the number of tokens required for downstream generative modeling with state-of-the-art flow models, while preserving the semantic structure needed for high-quality synthesis. Our tokenizer offers a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. TrackTok achieves comparable class-conditional generative FVD on UCF-101 dataset at 8 × 8\times fewer latent tokens and better latency, and outperforms existing 1D tokenization baselines on frame prediction task on Kinetics-600 across low token budgets. These results suggest that object-aligned and temporally persistent tokenization is a promising direction for scalable video generation, where reducing latent token counts is critical for efficient modeling. Our code for this work is available at github.com/phamleyennhi/tracktok .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 TrackTok，一种高效的视频分词框架，可生成以对象为中心的词元，即在整个时间段内始终编码相同语义对象的词元，即使对象发生移动、形变或部分遮挡。 传统的基于图像块的分词器或现有的整体式分词器所产生的词元身份通常与固定的图像位置绑定。 相比之下，我们的方法学习时间上持久的以对象为中心的表示，将跨帧的视觉特征绑定为稳定的语义单元。 这使得潜在视频表示更加紧凑且连续，在使用最先进的流模型进行下游生成建模时减少了所需词元的数量，同时保留了高质量合成所需的语义结构。 我们的分词器在质量与效率之间实现了良好的权衡。 TrackTok 在 UCF-101 数据集上以少 8 × 8 倍的潜在词元数达到可比的类条件生成 FVD 以及更低的延迟，并在 Kinetics-600 的帧预测任务上于各种低词元预算下超越现有的 1D 分词基线。 这些结果表明，与对象对齐且时间持久的分词是可扩展视频生成的一个有前景的方向，因为在高效建模中减少潜在词元数量至关重要。 本工作的代码可在 github.com/phamleyennhi/tracktok 获取。

paragraphs.en: Autoencoding videos into compressed latent spaces is an active research area with large impact on efficient video streaming and generative modeling Xing et al. (2024) ; Yin et al. (2025) ; HaCohen et al. (2026) . An optimal autoencoder should encode videos into a representation that is (1) highly compressive and (2) allows for high-quality video generation in latent space, i.e., being easy to process by current-gen, large-scale generative models, such as video diffusion models Blattmann et al. (2023) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; Wan et al. (2025) or autoregressive transformers Hong et al. (2023) ; Yu et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2024b) . We refer to compression as the number of latent tokens a video is encoded into, as it is the quantity that primarily governs the cost of the downstream generative model: attention in diffusion transformers over continuous latents scales in the token count, while for autoregressive transformers over discrete latents the token count directly equals the number of network function evaluations (NFEs). A promising recent direction are tokenizers that map videos into unstructured sets of tokens, which are not aligned with the spatiotemporal grid of input video tokens Wang et al. (2025) ; Tan et al. (2025) . In this paper, we present TrackTok , a novel tokenizer of this category that represents videos as semantic, object-centric tokens, achieving a state-of-the-art trade-off in compression vs. generation quality (c.f. Fig. 1 left).

paragraphs.en: Videos often contain redundant information: a set of entities is moving through an otherwise static scene, where the existence of an individual entity remains persistent while its location is changing. Current tokenizers do not fully leverage this redundancy as they compress video patches but maintain the spatial and temporal dimensions Rombach et al. (2022) ; Zhao et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024a) . We show that even existing holistic autoencoders Wang et al. (2025) , while already compressing videos into 1D tokens sets or sequences, still fall back to encoding fixed spatial locations into individual tokens. Thus, when an object moves through a scene and changes location in pixel space, the representing token changes multiple times across the video, failing to disentangle the object’s existence and its location, and thus failing to utilize the given redundancy.
paragraphs.zh: 视频通常包含冗余信息：一组实体在原本静态的场景中移动，其中单个实体的存在保持不变，而其位置却在变化。 当前的分词器并未充分利用这种冗余，因为它们只是压缩视频补丁，却保留了空间和时间维度 Rombach et al. (2022) ; Zhao et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024a) 。 我们表明，即使是现有的整体式自编码器 Wang et al. (2025) ，虽然已经将视频压缩为一维token集合或序列，但仍退回到将固定空间位置编码为单个token的做法。 因此，当一个物体在场景中移动并在像素空间中改变位置时，表示它的token会在整个视频中多次变化，未能将物体的存在与其位置解耦，从而未能利用给定的冗余。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, TrackTok clusters the scene into individual semantic regions, usually objects, in an unsupervised manner and represents them persistently with the same tokens over the course of the video (c.f. Fig. 1 right). We achieve this by designing a perceiver-based encoder that leverages V-JEPA 2.1 Mur-Labadia et al. (2026) as feature extractor and grounds the cross-attention mechanism between latent and input video tokens in semantic, input-dependent cluster queries instead of input-independent positional embeddings. Thus, latent token identity is defined by semantic features instead of arbitrary optimized embeddings. We find that this mechanism provides a drastically different inductive bias, leading to latent tokens specializing on semantic instances instead of spatiotemporal locations.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，TrackTok 以无监督的方式将场景聚类为单个语义区域（通常是物体），并在整个视频过程中用相同的 token 持久地表示它们（参见图 1 右侧）。 我们通过设计一个基于 perceiver 的编码器来实现这一点，该编码器利用 V-JEPA 2.1 Mur-Labadia et al. (2026) 作为特征提取器，并将潜在 token 与输入视频 token 之间的交叉注意力机制建立在语义化、依赖输入的聚类查询上，而不是与输入无关的位置嵌入。 因此，潜在 token 的身份由语义特征而非任意优化的嵌入来定义。 我们发现这种机制提供了一种截然不同的归纳偏置，使潜在 token 专注于语义实例而非时空位置。

paragraphs.en: We introduce TrackTok , a novel video tokenizer that encodes videos into a 1D set of object-aligned, latent tokens.

paragraphs.en: We present a novel mechanism to introduce inductive biases into perceiver architectures, controlling which property is used by the network to cluster via cross-attention. By using semantic cluster queries, the model learns to perform attention based on object semantics.

With the success of latent diffusion and flow models Rombach et al. (2022) , the goal of continuous tokenization has shifted towards compression for more efficient latent generation.

paragraphs.en: 1D Fixed-length Tokenization. Recent work Yu et al. (2024b) ; Bachmann et al. (2025) ; Wen et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; Tan et al. (2025) ; Atanov et al. (2026) proposes 1D token sets as latent representations. TiTok Yu et al. (2024b) compresses images into a fixed-size set of just 32 32 tokens using transformer architecture. Our main baseline LARP Wang et al. (2025) extends this paradigm to videos, requiring > 1 ​ k >1k tokens to achieve sufficient reconstruction quality. FlexTok Atanov et al. (2026) resamples images into flexible-length 1D token sequences acting as conditioning for a generative decoder. All these methods are optimized for autoregressive generation with discrete tokens from a fixed-size codebook. This limits compression in comparison with continuous tokenizers, as only the choice of tokens but not the tokens themselves are input-dependent. We propose TrackTok , a 1D continuous tokenizer for latent video diffusion, achieving stronger compression by encoding vision foundation features into object-centric tokens.

paragraphs.en: Foundation Models for Visual Tokenization. Following success in leveraging vision foundation models (VFMs) like DINO Caron et al. (2021) ; Oquab et al. (2024) to speed up training of latent diffusion models Yu et al. (2025) , recent works investigate the use of VFMs for continuous tokenizers. VA-VAE Yao et al. (2025) aligns latents of a 2D VAE with DINO features, boosting training efficiency. RAE Zheng et al. (2026) and VFM-VAE Bi et al. (2026) directly use DINO as frozen encoder and train image decoders on top. However, these approaches are limited to generation with latent tokens representing patch-level information. In contrast, with a much smaller token set, TrackTok achieve similar video generation quality by learning object-centric tokens. This object-centricity is key to simultaneously enable strong compression and latent diffusability. Although existing approaches above learn 1D token sequences, they lack this property, showing strong spatial biases of tokens. Our representation is especially useful for videos, as the tokens are encouranged to be semantically persistent over time .

paragraphs.en: Object-centric learning (OCL) aims to represent images or videos as latent variables that correspond to individual physical objects. Slot Attention Locatello et al. (2020) popularized OCL by introducing a modular bottleneck in form of a permutation-invariant set of slots that learn to bind to objects, trained end-to-end for reconstruction. SAVi Kipf et al. (2022) ; Elsayed et al. (2022) , STEVE Singh et al. (2022) , and SlotContrast Manasyan et al. (2025) extend this paradigm to videos. With the rise of VFMs, recent works Seitzer et al. (2023) ; Zadaianchuk et al. (2023) ; Aydemir et al. (2023) combine slot attention with semantic feature extraction and self-supervision objectives. These object-centric autoencoders are not designed as video tokenizers for latent video generation. They are optimized for unsupervised object discovery and are known for insufficient reconstruction quality due to strong architectural bottlenecks.
paragraphs.zh: 以对象为中心的学习（OCL）旨在将图像或视频表示为与单个物理对象相对应的隐变量。 Slot Attention（Locatello 等人， 2020）通过引入一种模块化瓶颈来推广 OCL，其形式为置换不变的槽集合，这些槽学习绑定到对象，并以端到端方式训练用于重建。SAVi（Kipf 等人，2022；Elsayed 等人， 2022）、STEVE（Singh 等人， 2022）以及 SlotContrast（Manasyan 等人， 2025）将这一范式扩展到视频。 随着 VFM 的兴起，近期工作（Seitzer 等人， 2023；Zadaianchuk 等人，2023；Aydemir 等人， 2023）将槽注意力与语义特征提取和自监督目标相结合。 这些以对象为中心的自编码器并非被设计为用于隐空间视频生成的视频分词器。 它们为无监督对象发现而优化，并且由于强大的架构瓶颈，其重建质量不足而广为人知。

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, TrackTok is the first video tokenizer for latent generation, revisiting ideas of OCL to learn a token representation that is highly compressed, semantically meaningful, and therefore efficient for generative modeling with state-of-the-art diffusion and flow models.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，TrackTok 是首个用于潜在生成的视频分词器，它重新审视了 OCL 的思想，以学习一种高度压缩、具有语义意义的 token 表示，从而在使用最先进的扩散模型和流模型进行生成建模时更加高效。

paragraphs.en: We present a novel video autoencoder architecture, TrackTok , consisting of a frozen vision foundation model that extracts semantic features from a video, a trained Vision Transformer that encodes semantic feature patches into an object-aligned latent representation, and a trained decoder that reconstructs RGB videos from the encoded semantic information (see Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的视频自编码器架构 TrackTok，它由以下部分组成：一个冻结的视觉基础模型，用于从视频中提取语义特征；一个经过训练的 Vision Transformer，用于将语义特征块编码为与物体对齐的潜在表示；以及一个经过训练的解码器，用于从编码后的语义信息重建 RGB 视频（见图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Formally, the encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} encodes a video 𝐕 ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] 3 × T × H × W \mathbf{V}\in[0,1]^{3\times T\times H\times W} into a fixed-size set of latent tokens 𝒵 = { 𝐳 i ∈ ℝ D } i = 1 N \mathcal{Z}=\{\mathbf{z}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{D}\}_{i=1}^{N} . We leverage V-JEPA 2.1 Mur-Labadia et al. (2026) as feature extractor and introduce cluster queries to bias the encoder towards learning object-centric, semantically persistent tokens. This representation enables both high compression and efficient training of a latent flow model. paragraphs.en: Our goal is to learn an object-centric latent representation that encodes and tracks semantically persistent units into individual tokens shared across all frames of a video clip. The key to achieve this goal is to design the right inductive biases for a learnable encoder. Our TrackTok encoder consists of three components: (1) semantic feature extraction using a pretrained VFM, (2) our cluster queries , and (3) a transformer encoder that transforms these queries into a compact set of video latents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是学习一种以对象为中心的潜在表示，将语义上持续存在的单元编码并跟踪为在视频片段所有帧之间共享的独立 token。 实现这一目标的关键在于为可学习的编码器设计合适的归纳偏置。 我们的 TrackTok 编码器由三个组件组成：(1) 使用预训练 VFM 进行语义特征提取，(2) 我们的聚类查询，以及 (3) 一个将这些查询转换为一组紧凑视频潜在变量的 transformer 编码器。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present our evaluation of TrackTok . Sec. 4.1 introduces our setup and Sec. 4.2 shows that our method presents a new frontier in efficient video encoding, well-suited for latent diffusion. In Sec. 4.3 , we analyze our tokens w.r.t. semantic object alignment and temporal consistency and in Sec. 4.4 we ablate on our design choices. See App. A for full implementation details.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们对 TrackTok 进行评估。第 4.1 节介绍了我们的实验设置，第 4.2 节表明我们的方法在高效视频编码方面开辟了新的前沿，非常适合潜在扩散。第 4.3 节分析了我们的 token 在语义对象对齐和时间一致性方面的表现，第 4.4 节对我们的设计选择进行了消融实验。完整的实现细节见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: In both class-conditional generation on UCF-101 and frame prediction on Kinetics-600, our TrackTok provides a new frontier in efficient video generation (see Table 1 , Fig. 3 ). On UCF-101, TrackTok maintains stable class-conditional generation quality across token budgets, achieving a comparable gFVD to that of LARP while using 8 × 8\times fewer tokens (128 vs. 1024). Even with just 32 tokens, TrackTok achieves a gFVD of 201 201 , while LARP and AdapTok degrade sharply, reaching gFVDs of 672 672 and 1525 1525 , respectively. On Kinetics-600 dataset, our method outperforms LARP and AdapTok at equal token counts in the low-token regime, with 4.9 × 4.9\times and 10.8 × 10.8\times better gFVD, respectively. TrackTok at 128 128 tokens ( 40.7 40.7 gFVD) is competitive with OmniTok at 4096 tokens ( 32.9 32.9 gFVD), despite using 32 × 32\times fewer latent tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 在 UCF-101 上的类条件生成和 Kinetics-600 上的帧预测两项任务中，我们的 TrackTok 都为高效视频生成开辟了新的前沿（见表 1、图 3）。 在 UCF-101 上，TrackTok 在不同词元预算下保持稳定的类条件生成质量，在使用少 8 × 8\times 的词元（128 对比 1024）的情况下，取得了与 LARP 相当的 gFVD。 即使仅使用 32 个词元，TrackTok 也达到了 201 201 的 gFVD，而 LARP 和 AdapTok 则急剧退化，gFVD 分别达到 672 672 和 1525 1525。 在 Kinetics-600 数据集上，在低词元区间内，我们的方法在相同词元数量下优于 LARP 和 AdapTok，gFVD 分别好 4.9 × 4.9\times 和 10.8 × 10.8\times。 使用 128 128 个词元的 TrackTok（gFVD 为 40.7 40.7）与使用 4096 个词元的 OmniTok（gFVD 为 32.9 32.9）具有竞争力，尽管其使用的潜在词元少 32 × 32\times。

paragraphs.en: We proposed TrackTok , a novel video tokenizer that enables learning of semantically persistent tokens that capture and track semantic units over time. This represents a shift in how we encode videos, moving from spatially localized embeddings to holistic tokens using foundational features as inductive bias. We showed that TrackTok provides a new frontier for efficient encodings for video generation, with 8 × 8\times fewer tokens at similar generative quality compared to previous methods. It enables up to 8 × 8\times higher sampling speed at similar generative quality compared to state-of-the-art compression-focused tokenizer, thus enabling an order of magnitude faster video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 TrackTok，一种新颖的视频分词器，能够学习语义持久的词元，以在时间维度上捕捉并跟踪语义单元。 这代表了视频编码方式的转变，即从空间局部化的嵌入转向利用基础特征作为归纳偏置的整体性词元。 我们证明了 TrackTok 为视频生成的高效编码开辟了新的前沿，与以往方法相比，在相近生成质量下词元数量减少了 8 × 8\times 倍。 与最先进的以压缩为目标的分词器相比，它在相近生成质量下可实现高达 8 × 8\times 倍的采样速度提升，从而使视频生成速度提升一个数量级。

paragraphs.en: Limitations and Future Work. For future research on video tokenizers, we see TrackTok -based approaches as an interesting alternative to spatially localized holistic tokens. Our analysis suggests that such representations might provide a new angle on scaling video autoencoders to long videos. In addition to high compression and efficiency, we see potential in object tracking and video editing applications, which can profit from the emerging object-centric property. One limitation of introducing the object-centric property via soft inductive biases is the adaptive behavior in the cluster-query allocation: when scene content changes substantially within a clip, the encoder sometimes allows moving objects from one token to another, rather than forcing a single token to remain persistent. We view this as a deliberate degree of flexibility of the token representation (c.f. first row, Fig. E6 in supplement). A natural direction for future work is to make this allocation explicit, e.g., by tying token persistence to scene-level priors so that long-range identity is preserved more strictly when the downstream application requires it. In summary, we suggest a shift from traditional spatiotemporal video tokenizer towards 1D token sequences with semantic inductive biases that serves as a proof of principle for more scalable video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性与未来工作。 对于未来关于视频分词器的研究，我们认为基于 TrackTok 的方法是空间定位的整体token的一种有吸引力的替代方案。 我们的分析表明，这类表示可能为将视频自编码器扩展到长视频提供一个新视角。 除了高压缩率和高效率之外，我们还看到目标跟踪和视频编辑应用方面的潜力，它们可以受益于这种涌现的目标中心特性。 通过软归纳偏置引入目标中心特性的一个局限在于簇-查询分配的自适应行为：当片段内场景内容发生显著变化时，编码器有时会允许运动目标从一个token迁移到另一个token，而不是强制单个token保持持久性。 我们将此视为token表示的一种有意保留的灵活程度（参见补充材料图 E6 第一行）。 未来工作的一个自然方向是使这种分配变得显式，例如将token的持久性与场景级先验绑定，以便在下游应用需要时更严格地保持长程身份一致性。 总而言之，我们建议从传统的时空视频分词器转向具有语义归纳偏置的一维token序列，以此作为更具可扩展性的视频生成的原理性证明。

sents.zh: 通过软归纳偏置引入目标中心特性的一个局限在于簇-查询分配的自适应行为：当片段内场景内容发生显著变化时，编码器有时会允许运动目标从一个token迁移到另一个token，而不是强制单个token保持持久性。

sents.en: We view this as a deliberate degree of flexibility of the token representation (c.f. first row, Fig. E6 in supplement).
sents.zh: 我们将此视为token表示的一种有意保留的灵活程度（参见补充材料图 E6 第一行）。

sents.en: A natural direction for future work is to make this allocation explicit, e.g., by tying token persistence to scene-level priors so that long-range identity is preserved more strictly when the downstream application requires it.
sents.zh: 未来工作的一个自然方向是使这种分配变得显式，例如将token的持久性与场景级先验绑定，以便在下游应用需要时更严格地保持长程身份一致性。

sents.en: In summary, we suggest a shift from traditional spatiotemporal video tokenizer towards 1D token sequences with semantic inductive biases that serves as a proof of principle for more scalable video generation.
sents.zh: 总而言之，我们建议从传统的时空视频分词器转向具有语义归纳偏置的一维token序列，以此作为更具可扩展性的视频生成的原理性证明。

paragraphs.en: We provide a detailed description of the training recipes used for the TrackTok tokenizer and the LightningDiT-XL denoiser. paragraphs.en: For a direct and fair comparison with baselines LARP [ 1 ] and AdapTok [ 2 ] , we train both our tokenizers and denoisers with the exaxt same data as these baselines. In specific, all our tokenizers on the combined dataset of UCF-101 and Kinetics-600 at 16 × 128 × 128 16{\times}128{\times}128 with random horizontal flipping. For class-conditional generation, we train our denoisers only on UCF-101 dataset; for frame predicition, we train our denoisers only on Kinetics-600 dataset. For evaluation, we use the validation split of each dataset at the same resolution, with center cropping.
paragraphs.zh: 为了与基线方法 LARP [1] 和 AdapTok [2] 进行直接且公平的比较，我们使用与这些基线完全相同的数据来训练我们的智能体分词器和去噪器。 具体而言，我们所有的分词器都在 UCF-101 和 Kinetics-600 的组合数据集上，以 16 × 128 × 128 16{\times}128{\times}128 的分辨率并进行随机水平翻转进行训练。 对于类别条件生成，我们仅在 UCF-101 数据集上训练去噪器；对于帧预测，我们仅在 Kinetics-600 数据集上训练去噪器。 在评估时，我们在相同分辨率下使用每个数据集的验证集划分，并进行中心裁剪。

paragraphs.en: Our encoder and decoder designs consist each of 12-layer transformers with hidden size 768 768 and 12 12 heads. Given the input video of 16 16 frames, the semantic features are extracted from a frozen V-JEPA2.1 ViT-L/16 at the 128 × 128 128{\times}128 resolution with patch size 2 × 16 × 16 2{\times}16{\times}16 . We perform k k -Means clustering with 20 20 Lloyd iterations on the V-JEPA2.1 features and pool each cluster with a shared-identity multi-query head: each query concatenates the cluster centroid, per-frame bilinearly interpolated positional embeddings of dimension d PE = 64 d_{\text{PE}}{=}64 , and a learned identity embedding of dimension d id = 32 d_{\text{id}}{=}32 that is shared across clusters. We vary the token budget by jointly adjusting the number of clusters K K , the number of query tokens per cluster, and the bottleneck dimension d d . For budgets of 32 32 , 64 64 , and 128 128 tokens, we fix K = 32 K{=}32 and use 1 1 , 2 2 , and 4 4 query tokens per cluster, respectively, with d = 128 d{=}128 . For larger budgets of 256 256 , 512 512 , and 1024 1024 tokens, we progressively reduce K K to 16 16 , 8 8 , and 4 4 , while increasing the number of query tokens per cluster to 16 16 , 64 64 , and 256 256 , and reducing d d to 64 64 , 32 32 , and 16 16 , respectively. This allows us to explore different allocations of representational capacity across number of clusters, query tokens, and feature dimensions under varying token budgets. Refer to Sec. D for a quantitative ablation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的编码器和解码器设计各由12层Transformer组成，隐藏层大小为768 768，注意力头数为12 12。 对于16 16帧的输入视频，语义特征从冻结的V-JEPA2.1 ViT-L/16中提取，分辨率为128 × 128 128{\times}128，补丁大小为2 × 16 × 16 2{\times}16{\times}16。 我们对V-JEPA2.1特征执行k k-均值聚类，进行20 20次Lloyd迭代，并通过共享身份的多查询头对每个簇进行池化：每个查询拼接簇质心、逐帧双线性插值的维度为d PE = 64 d_{\text{PE}}{=}64的位置嵌入，以及一个维度为d id = 32 d_{\text{id}}{=}32、在各簇间共享的可学习身份嵌入。 我们通过联合调整簇数K K、每个簇的查询token数量以及瓶颈维度d d来改变token预算。 对于32 32、64 64和128 128个token的预算，我们固定K = 32 K{=}32，分别使用每簇1 1、2 2和4 4个查询token，并设d = 128 d{=}128。 对于更大的256 256、512 512和1024 1024个token的预算，我们逐步将K K降低到16 16、8 8和4 4，同时将每个簇的查询token数量增加到16 16、64 64和256 256，并将d d分别降至64 64、32 32和16 16。 这使我们能够在不同token预算下，探索簇数、查询token和特征维度之间不同的表示能力分配方式。参见第 D节的定量消融实验。

paragraphs.en: We further describe our denoiser setup for class-conditional generation and frame prediction tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步描述了用于类条件生成和帧预测任务的降噪器设置。

paragraphs.en: We train a LightningDiT-XL [ 32 ] flow-matching denoiser with hidden size 1152 1152 , 28 28 transformer blocks, and 16 16 attention heads. Following Table 7 of [ 32 ] we use only absolute (frequency) positional embeddings; the rotary relative positional embedding is disabled. The denoiser operates directly on the frozen tokenizer’s normalized latents, where the normalization statistics are precomputed per tokenizer on the UCF-101 training split for class-conditional generation, and on Kinetics-600 training subset for frame prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们训练了一个 LightningDiT-XL [32] 流匹配去噪器，其隐藏层大小为 1152 1152，包含 28 28 个 transformer 块和 16 16 个注意力头。 按照 [32] 的表 7，我们仅使用绝对（频率）位置嵌入；旋转式相对位置嵌入被禁用。 去噪器直接作用于冻结分词器的归一化潜变量，其中归一化统计量是在 UCF-101 训练集划分上针对类别条件生成、以及在 Kinetics-600 训练子集上针对帧预测，按每个分词器预先计算的。

paragraphs.en: Each video is split into consecutive, non-overlapping 4 4 -frame clips (the last clip is padded by repeating its final frame, and padded frames are not scored), and each clip is tokenized independently. This measures what each token encodes after decoding rather than how the encoder groups its inputs, and is applied identically to all three tokenizers.

paragraphs.en: Token identities are only meaningful within a clip, so we link tokens causally across clips. paragraphs.en: We derive segmentations from the tokens by assigning each pixel to its owning token via token ablation. paragraphs.en: Token purity measures how consistently a token represents a single object. For a token, we compute the fraction of its foreground pixels belonging to its dominant object, then average across tokens weighted by their foreground area. For example, a token covering 90 % 90\% object 1 and 10 % 10\% object 2 has 90 % 90\% purity. Purity is computed on raw per-clip tokens and does not penalize fragmentation: splitting an object across many small tokens can still yield high purity.
paragraphs.zh: Token 纯度衡量一个 token 表征单一对象的一致程度。 对于每个 token，我们计算其前景像素中属于其主导对象的比例，然后按各 token 的前景面积加权，在所有 token 上取平均。 例如，一个覆盖 90% 90\% 对象 1 和 10% 10\% 对象 2 的 token，其纯度为 90% 90\%。 纯度是在原始的逐 clip token 上计算的，且不惩罚碎片化：将一个对象拆分到多个小 token 上仍可能获得高纯度。

paragraphs.en: Object discovery measures whether tokens capture whole objects within individual frames, without linking identities across clips. Token IDs are local to each 4-frame clip, and frames without annotated objects are excluded. FG-ARI measures clustering agreement between token IDs and ground-truth instance IDs on foreground pixels ( 0 0 indicates chance-level agreement; 1 1 indicates a perfect match). It penalizes both splitting an object across tokens and merging multiple objects into one token, regardless of how tokens are assigned to the background. mBO computes the IoU between each ground-truth object and its best-matching token mask, including background pixels, then averages over objects. Matching is not one-to-one, so mBO measures how completely a single token covers each object.
paragraphs.zh: 目标发现衡量词元（token）能否在单帧内捕捉完整的目标，而不涉及跨片段的身份关联。 词元 ID 仅在各自的 4 帧片段内是局部的，且不含标注目标的帧会被排除。 FG-ARI 衡量在前景像素上词元 ID 与真实实例 ID 之间聚类的一致性（0 表示与随机水平相当的一致性；1 表示完全匹配）。 它既惩罚将一个目标拆分到多个词元的情况，也惩罚将多个目标合并到一个词元的情况，而不考虑词元如何分配到背景。mBO 计算每个真实目标与其最佳匹配词元掩码之间的 IoU（包含背景像素），然后对目标取平均。 匹配并非一一对应，因此 mBO 衡量的是单个词元对每个目标的覆盖完整程度。

paragraphs.en: Object tracking measures whether token identities remain consistent across frames. After linking and merging, tokens receive global track IDs, producing a single label map for the entire video. Video FG-ARI evaluates clustering agreement across all foreground pixels in all frames, penalizing object fragmentation, merging, and identity switches. Video mBO matches each object to its best-overlapping track across the video and averages IoU over objects. 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} evaluates region overlap ( 𝒥 \mathcal{J} , IoU) and boundary accuracy ( ℱ \mathcal{F} ). We average both measures over annotated frames for each object–track pair, then use Hungarian matching to assign tracks to objects based on their mean ( 𝒥 + ℱ ) / 2 (\mathcal{J}+\mathcal{F})/2 ; unmatched objects score zero. Matching is performed once per video, requiring each track to follow its object throughout the video for a high score.

paragraphs.en: In section 4.1 , we described how to visualize the token impact on high level. To probe what each latent token encodes, we conduct two analyses:
paragraphs.zh: 在第 4.1 节中，我们描述了如何在高层面上可视化词元的影响。 为了探究每个潜在词元编码了什么内容，我们进行了两项分析：

sents.en: In section 4.1 , we described how to visualize the token impact on high level.
sents.zh: 在第 4.1 节中，我们描述了如何在高层面上可视化词元的影响。

sents.en: To probe what each latent token encodes, we conduct two analyses:
sents.zh: 为了探究每个潜在词元编码了什么内容，我们进行了两项分析：

paragraphs.en: Per-token impact per sample : for a fixed input video we encode once, then re-decode after zeroing a single token at a time, yielding a per-pixel L 2 L_{2} error map for every token. We assign each pixel to the token whose removal most affects it and color the resulting impact map by projecting each token’s latent vector onto the top-three principal components of the latent set. This makes both the spatial support of a token and the similarity structure between tokens visible in a single frame.
paragraphs.zh: 每个样本的逐词元影响：对于固定的输入视频，我们先编码一次，然后每次将单个词元置零后重新解码，从而为每个词元得到一个逐像素的 L 2 L_{2} 误差图。 我们将每个像素分配给移除后对其影响最大的词元，并通过将每个词元的潜在向量投影到潜在集合的前三个主成分上，为所得的影响图着色。 这使得词元的空间支持范围以及词元之间的相似性结构都能在单帧中可见。

sents.en: Per-token impact per sample : for a fixed input video we encode once, then re-decode after zeroing a single token at a time, yielding a per-pixel L 2 L_{2} error map for every token.
sents.zh: 每个样本的逐词元影响：对于固定的输入视频，我们先编码一次，然后每次将单个词元置零后重新解码，从而为每个词元得到一个逐像素的 L 2 L_{2} 误差图。

sents.en: We assign each pixel to the token whose removal most affects it and color the resulting impact map by projecting each token’s latent vector onto the top-three principal components of the latent set.
sents.zh: 我们将每个像素分配给移除后对其影响最大的词元，并通过将每个词元的潜在向量投影到潜在集合的前三个主成分上，为所得的影响图着色。

sents.en: This makes both the spatial support of a token and the similarity structure between tokens visible in a single frame.
sents.zh: 这使得词元的空间支持范围以及词元之间的相似性结构都能在单帧中可见。

paragraphs.en: Per-token impact across samples : for each token 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} , we average its per-pixel ablation error across all clips in the validation split, producing average token-indexed heatmaps.
paragraphs.zh: 跨样本的逐词元影响：对于每个词元 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} ，我们计算其在验证集分割中所有片段上的逐像素消融误差平均值，生成按词元索引的平均热力图。

paragraphs.en: We examine whether tokens consistently bind to semantic regions over time using the two complementary ablation-based visualizations introduced in App. C.1 . A token that consistently encodes the same spatial region produces a sharp, localized blob, whereas a token whose role varies across inputs produces a more diffuse map. This provides a direct measure of each tokenizer’s spatial bias.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用附录 C.1 中介绍的两种基于消融的互补可视化方法，检验词元是否随时间持续绑定到相同的语义区域。 持续编码同一空间区域的词元会产生清晰、局部化的斑点，而其角色随输入变化的词元则会产生更加弥散的映射图。 这为每个分词器的空间偏置提供了直接的度量。

paragraphs.en: We extend the per-token impact analysis in Sec. 4.3 to the dataset level in Fig. C1 . For each tokenizer, we encode every clip in the UCF-101 validation split and re-decode it after zeroing each token 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} , yielding a per-pixel L 2 L_{2} ablation error. Averaging these errors across the validation set produces one influence map per token, capturing where it tends to act independently of the input scene . paragraphs.en: Besides average pooling and subsampling, we add a clustering baseline at the same token budget. This provides a strong baseline for testing whether TrackTok’s performance gain at low token count could be obtained directly with semantic V-JEPA2.1 cluster centroids as latent tokens, rather than learning a 1D token set from our cluster-initialised queries. Tab. paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether language-level semantic representations suffice for video reconstruction, we caption 16-frame UCF-101 clips using pretrained Qwen2.5-VL [ 56 ] and reconstruct the videos from captions alone using Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B [ 8 ] . We generate four candidates per caption and report both the best candidate selected by LPIPS (oracle-4) and a fixed single-candidate result. We evaluate both using the same protocol as TrackTok on UCF-101. As shown in Tab. D7 , despite capturing high-level semantics, captions alone yield substantially poorer reconstruction quality. This suggests that language-level descriptions lack the spatial grounding and fine-grained appearance, motion, and scene-specific details needed for faithful video reconstruction.
